Hero.subtitle: A unique destination blending the comfort of a luxury guesthouse with the vibrant flavors of a public social space.

Home.welcomeText: Nestled in the heart of nature, AQEYO offers a unique fusion of peaceful accommodation and culinary excellence. Whether you're seeking a restful escape in our cozy guesthouse or looking to indulge your taste buds at our lively social space, we promise an unforgettable experience enriched with local charm and warmth.
Home.offeringsSubtitle: From comfortable stays to artisan coffee, explore what makes us special.
Home.guesthouseText: Relax in our beautifully designed rooms, featuring modern amenities, serene garden views, and the ultimate comfort for a perfect night's sleep.
Home.socialSpaceText: Savor locally sourced coffee, delicious meals, and mouth-watering desserts in a vibrant, open-air setting perfect for socializing or unwinding.
Home.ctaText: Book your stay today and experience the magic of AQEYO.
Home.usp1Desc: Located in the lush village of Kotaraja, far from city noise, offering total peace.
Home.usp2Desc: Rent the entire property which includes a private pool, modern kitchen, and hotel-standard rooms.
Home.usp3Desc: Enjoy authentic local cuisine and selected coffee directly in an integrated aesthetic cafe.
Home.expOverline: More Than Just A Place To Stay
Home.expTitle: Feel the Warmth of Nature & Local Hospitality
Home.expDesc1: Every corner at AQEYO House is designed to take you away from the hustle and bustle of the city. The aesthetic design that blends with the green rural environment creates an unforgettable relaxing atmosphere.
Home.expDesc2: Whether you are looking for quality time with family in a private villa, or just enjoying the afternoon sipping authentic coffee in our social space—all these experiences are woven with sincere and warm service.
Home.galleryDesc1: Every corner at AQEYO is designed to create unforgettable memories. From family togetherness in the warm living room, laughter by the private pool, to a quiet dusk accompanied by an authentic cup of coffee in our social space.
Home.galleryDesc2: See how our guests enjoy their best moments. Capture and share your beautiful memories with us.
Home.faq1Q: Where exactly is AQEYO House & Social Space located?
Home.faq1A: We are located in Kotaraja Village, Sikur, East Lombok. The environment is very beautiful and quiet, about 1 hour drive from downtown Mataram.
Home.faq2Q: Do I need to reserve a table before coming to the cafe?
Home.faq2A: For regular visits, you can just walk in. However, for groups of more than 5 people or special events, we highly recommend booking in advance via WhatsApp.
Home.faq3Q: How is the down payment (DP) system for Villa rental?
Home.faq3A: We require a down payment (DP) of 50% to secure your booking date. Full payment can be made during check-in.
Home.faq4A: Yes, we have a private parking area that is quite spacious and safe for cars and motorcycles of both guests and cafe visitors.

Footer.description: Experience the perfect blend of serenity and flavor. A unique guesthouse and social space destination designed for your comfort and delight.

Rooms.heroSubtitle: Experience comfort, style, and serenity in our thoughtfully designed rooms.
Rooms.facilitiesSubtitle: Enjoy limitless comfort with complete facilities specially designed to meet all your holiday needs with your family.
Rooms.fac1Desc: Spacious bedrooms equipped with King-size beds, air conditioning (AC), and exclusive en-suite bathrooms. Designed with warm lighting to give you the best quality of sleep. Standard capacity of 4 adults, can be added up to 6 people with extra beds.
Rooms.fac2Desc: Release your fatigue by swimming or simply relaxing by our private pool. This area is surrounded by lush tropical trees, providing a fresh atmosphere and full privacy for you and your family.
Rooms.fac3Desc: No need to worry about food. We provide a modern kitchen fully equipped with a stove, refrigerator, water dispenser, and complete cookware. A natural wooden long dining table is also available for warm dinners together.
Rooms.priceSubtitle: Choose the accommodation package that best suits your holiday needs. All accommodation packages (1-4) include breakfast.
Rooms.opt1RegulDesc: The entire area becomes private for you without any outside cafe guests.
Rooms.opt2RegulDesc: The outside area remains open for Social Space (Cafe) guests.
Rooms.rulesSubtitle: For mutual comfort, please pay attention to some of our property policies below.
Rooms.rule1: Additional cost for Extra Bed is IDR 50,000 / bed.
Rooms.rule2: Smoking is prohibited inside the bedrooms (designated smoking areas available).
Rooms.rule3: Pets are not allowed in the property area.
Rooms.rule4: Guests must maintain quietness, especially after 22:00 WITA.
Rooms.whySubtitle: Your trust and comfort are our management's top priorities. We are committed to providing high-standard hospitality services with a touch of local friendliness.
Rooms.why1Desc: Strict sanitation and room cleanliness standards. Bed linens are replaced fresh for every incoming guest, ensuring you sleep comfortably and hygienically.
Rooms.why2Desc: Our team is always ready to assist you with all your needs during your stay, from local tourism recommendations to technical assistance inside the house.
Rooms.why3Desc: A safe and quiet environment. If you choose the Full Rental option, your family's privacy is perfectly maintained without any outside interference.
Rooms.ctaSubtitle: Contact us now to check villa availability and get the best offers exclusively today.

SocialSpace.heroSubtitle: A culinary journey savoring local dishes with authentic Lombok flavors.
SocialSpace.promoText: 10% discount on all F&B menus for guests staying at AQEYO House!
SocialSpace.vibeTitle: A Place Where Taste & Stories Meet
SocialSpace.vibeDesc: At AQEYO Social Space, we believe that delicious food is even better when shared. With a semi-open architecture that blends with nature, selected local coffee brews, and a soothing breeze, this place is perfectly designed for afternoon chats, remote working, or simply celebrating life.
SocialSpace.menuSubtitle: Made with fresh ingredients, authentic recipes, and local spirit.
SocialSpace.high1Desc: Enjoy the warmth of Indonesian home cooking. From the savory Nasi Rawon to the fragrant Nasi Bakar Kemangi, all are mixed with selected spices just like a mother's cooking.
SocialSpace.high2Desc: The best choice for dining with family or groups. Served complete (Complete Meal Set) with Nusantara flavors.
SocialSpace.atmosDesc1: We designed AQEYO Social Space with a blend of modern industrial elements and the beauty of tropical nature. The gentle breeze, natural sunlight, and spacious seating layout give you true breathing freedom.
SocialSpace.atmosDesc2: Whether you come alone to focus on work, or with a group to relax, there is a special corner waiting for you here.
SocialSpace.eventDesc: Need a place for a birthday party, gathering, small meeting, or reunion? AQEYO Social Space provides special packages for your event.
SocialSpace.visitDesc: Located in Kotaraja Village, Sikur, East Lombok. We look forward to your presence to enjoy the signature dishes and atmosphere of AQEYO House.
SocialSpace.payDesc: We accept Cash, QRIS (All E-Wallets/Mobile Banking), and Bank Transfers.
SocialSpace.resDesc: Make sure you get the best seat. Please fill out the form below to make a reservation.

Gallery.heroSubtitle: Your moments of togetherness and AQEYO will be captured here.
Gallery.title: AQEYO Visual Collection
Gallery.desc: Exploring every corner that holds a story. From the calming architectural design in our guesthouse, to the warm moments created in the social space. Find your next holiday inspiration through our camera lens.

Contact.heroSubtitle: Get to know AQEYO House & Social Space better.
Contact.storyDesc: Starting from a dream to create a space where everyone can briefly escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, AQEYO House stands as an oasis of calm amidst the beautiful nature of East Lombok.
Contact.visionDesc: To become the main choice for a *guesthouse* and *social space* destination in Lombok that offers a perfect blend of natural beauty, aesthetic architecture, and sincere local hospitality.
Contact.mission1: Providing exclusive, clean, and private accommodation facilities.
Contact.mission2: Serving a variety of local cuisines with the best ingredients and authentic flavors.
Contact.mission3: Providing personal and warm service like in your own home.
Contact.infoDesc: Have questions about room booking or our cafe menu? Contact us via WhatsApp, Instagram, email, or visit us directly.
Contact.addressVal: Kotaraja, Sikur, East Lombok, NTB, Indonesia
Contact.hoursVal:
Every Day: 08:00 - 22:00 WITA
(Outside these hours, we will reply to messages the next day)
Contact.dirDesc: AQEYO House is located in the cool and beautiful Kotaraja Village. About 45 minutes overland journey from Lombok International Airport (BIZAM) or about 1 hour drive from Mataram city center.
